outreach_template._comment: Template that earned a same-day reply from Acumen Builders on 2026-07-29. Personalize the city in the subject line and the geography line in the body.
outreach_template.subject: Garage door sub for your {CITY} builds - local, from $1,950 installed
outreach_template.body:
Hi {NAME},

I'm Taras, owner of Viking Garage Door in Boiling Springs. We install and service garage doors across Spartanburg and Greenville counties, and I'd like to earn a spot as your garage door sub.

Why builders work with us:

- Turnkey install from $1,950 per door; volume pricing on multi-door orders
- We follow your construction schedule - measure early, install on your date, no holdups before closing
- Licensed and insured, 4.8-star Google rating; recent installs: https://www.vikingdoor.net/garage-doors/
- After closing, your buyers call us for warranty and service - not you

{CITY} is an easy run for us. Happy to price out your next build - I can meet at the job.

Taras
Viking Garage Door LLC - Boiling Springs, SC 29316
(864) 921-7373 - vikingdoor.net

P.S. Not the right person or don't want these emails? Reply "pass" and I won't email again.

blocked_2026_08_05._comment: This run could not send.
